Both HP:0004469 or OMOP:256451 can be used to map chronic bronchitis. http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0004469 or https://athena.ohdsi.org/search-terms/terms/256451
The deciding factor is the BDCHM slot type.  
  Use MONDO:0005607  -   Note on "doctor stated"
  The variable description "doctor stated" signals physician-diagnosed chronic bronchitis — not a symptom report.
